name: How long does cabinet refinishing really last before it starts peeling or looking worn?

mainEntity.name: How long does cabinet refinishing really last before it starts peeling or looking worn?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professionally prepared and coated finish can last for years, but no finish is permanent or immune to impact, moisture, heat, and cleaning chemicals. Context: Longevity depends more on surface preparation, coating compatibility, film thickness, curing, and daily use than on color alone. Sink bases, dishwasher edges, drawer fronts, and frequently touched pulls usually receive the most wear. Key factors: - Existing laminate or thermofoil may need a specialized approach and may not perform like solid wood. - Excessive moisture and steam can weaken finishes around sinks and appliances. - Abrasive cleaners and aggressive scrubbing can shorten service life. Practical guidance: Ask which areas are most vulnerable and what cleaning products are acceptable. Confirm whether future touch-ups are practical and whether the contractor records the finish color or product system. A careful inspection by Elite Remodeling & Design can help determine whether refinishing or a different cabinet solution is the better long-term value.
acceptedAnswer.description: A well-prepared finish can last for years, but durability depends on cabinet material, preparation, coating compatibility, curing, moisture, heat, and cleaning habits. Sink areas, dishwasher edges, and frequently handled doors usually show wear first.
